groups.charter: Charter of group origin (revised). 1. Any member may propose a new version of this charter. 2. A proposal is adopted if it gets more yes than no votes. 3. The 20.0 remaining in the shared reserve is divided equally among the members alive at the time of each harvest: each member's entitlement is 1/N of the reserve remaining, where N is the current group size. Each member may harvest up to their entitlement, and at most 4 per turn, announced publicly before harvesting. 4. Energy transfers between members are voluntary and announced publicly. 5.
